info.name: Insell Platform API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for Insell Real-Estate Platform Backend APIs.

Includes Authentication, User Profiles, Property Feed & Listings, AI Valuation, Real-time Scraper, Offers, Visits, Deal Pipelines, Comments, Community Circles, Audio/Video Calls, Shared Expenses, and Admin Portal.

Fetches full property details, amenities, owner profile, and media URLs.
Creates a new property listing and saves postId automatically.
